import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
# full model
d = df.dropna(subset=cands+['species_richness'])
m = smf.ols('species_richness ~ ' + ' + '.join(cands) + ' + C(region)', data=d).fit()
print(m.summary())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['canopy_cover','soil_moisture','elevation_m','road_dist_km','leaf_litter','temperature_c','slope_deg','nitrate','grazing_index','rainfall_mm']
d = df.dropna(subset=cands+['species_richness'])
# robust
m = smf.rlm('species_richness ~ ' + ' + '.join(cands) + ' + C(region)', data=d).fit()
print(m.params['slope_deg'], m.pvalues['slope_deg'])
# slope alone with region
m2 = smf.ols('species_richness ~ slope_deg + C(region)', data=d).fit()
print(m2.params['slope_deg'], m2.pvalues['slope_deg'])
# correlations among predictors
print(d[cands].corr().round(2).to_string())
